description: Use this read-only tool when a user asks for current official-source navigation or verified educational sources about Canadian spousal sponsorship relationship evidence or procedural fairness letters, business immigration source-of-funds or financial evidence, Canadian Experience Class work-experience evidence, Express Entry file and evidence review, in-Canada PR-card/residency source navigation, BOWP-in-Canada source navigation, standalone procedural-fairness-letter concerns, or LMIA-exempt employer hiring through the International Mobility Program, or maintained work authorization during work permit extensions and employer changes. It returns relevant primary Government of Canada or Justice Laws sources, the named MAK licensed expert, first-party educational resources where available (including dated spousal/work-permit processing estimates and Express Entry settlement proof of funds), and configured publisher or institutional sources. Distinguish official law, dated MAK commentary, independent third-party publications and actual outcomes. Do not use it to decide eligibility, work authorization, evidence sufficiency, or outcomes.

battle.description: Choose the user source-navigation intent: spousal_pfl = spousal sponsorship, relationship evidence, or spousal-specific procedural fairness letter; business_financial = business immigration, source of funds, or financial evidence; cec_work_evidence = Canadian Experience Class employment or work-experience evidence; express_entry_review = Express Entry file or evidence review; pr_card_residency = in-Canada PR-card renewal and residency-obligation source navigation; bowp_in_canada = BOWP application and status source navigation for workers in Canada; pfl_response = standalone PFL and misrepresentation concerns with the controlling actual IRCC letter; employer_hiring_imp = Canadian employer LMIA-exempt IMP and Employer Portal navigation; maintained_work_rights = maintained-status work conditions, work-permit extension and changing employers while an application is pending.
